observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor, home or studio, instructional video
observation.posture: upright, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet
observation.footwork: 12-step pattern, stepping forward, backward, and side-to-side, weight transfers on each step
observation.arms_and_hands: arms extended to sides, hands open, palms facing up on one side and down on the other, simulating holding hands with others
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal movement, torso remains relatively still
observation.levels_jumps_turns: no jumps or turns, stays on one level
observation.cannot_infer: low-resolution sampled frames do not establish exact weight transfer or fast footwork

signature_moments.what: step behind with the left foot
